Real responses from the MusicBrainz web service, captured 2026-10-31 with
`GET https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/discid/<id>?inc=artist-credits+recordings+release-groups&fmt=json`
for the two development test discs. MusicBrainz core data is released into the public domain (CC0).
Used to test `musicbrainz::parse_discid_response` against the real shape of the data.
